name: On-chain Forensics API
description: Decision-grade on-chain forensics for AI agents. Ask the question you are actually asking: should I touch this token or wallet? Verdict returns a letter grade A to F with a one-line roast, risk flags and a data_quality verdict, so a caller gets a call to make rather than a dashboard to read. Pay per call in USDC on Base via x402, no API keys, no signup, free trial calls with trial=1.
payment: x402 v2, USDC on Base (eip155:8453), pay-per-call, exact scheme

starter.why: Three calls, 0.06 USD, enough to decide whether to trade, settle against it, or walk away.

calls.answers: Is this token alive, who moves it, and does it grade as risky?
Can I accept or settle against this token right now without a honeypot, pause or clawback?
Who is adding supply in this window, and how much?

free_trial.how: Append trial=1 to verdict, settlesafe, token, wallet or any single-question read for free daily calls per IP. No payment header, no signup.

guarantees: Every payload states data_quality COMPLETE, PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE; an unreadable chain is never reported as a zero and an unattributable address is never reported as a guess.
Reads come from a dedicated Alchemy endpoint this service controls, with public gateways only as fallback.
No LLM in the decision path: grades, tiers and roasts are deterministic functions of on-chain reads, so the same block gives the same answer.

verdict.answers: Is this token alive and how risky?

settlesafe.answers: Can I settle against it right now?

trust.answers: One word: TRUSTED, CAUTION, HIGH_RISK, UNVERIFIABLE.

deployer.answers: Who launched this contract, and from which wallet?

token.answers: Full token profile: supply, concentration, whale moves.

wallet.answers: Is this wallet worth trusting with settlement?

memo.answers: A composed due-diligence answer for one token or wallet.

sweep.answers: Does this wallet actually hold what it claims?

verdictFast.answers: Same verdict as above, cached, in milliseconds.

cached_tier.why: Sub-cent and low latency: precomputed continuously in the background, answered from a key lookup instead of a 1 to 14 second chain scan. Same grade and roast as the $0.02 live verdict.
cached_tier.miss_policy: No charge when a token is not in the feed; the response says cache_miss and points at the live $0.02 route.
cached_tier.growth: The universe is discovered automatically from the Uniswap token list and built in time-budgeted shards; coverage expands every ten minutes.
